release_notes: Build 65 adds a private Website Users management page for registered Factburst accounts, including verification/status, signup and activity dates, quiz totals, attempts, scores and accuracy.
Selecting a website user shows every quiz they have completed, their best result, accuracy, first/last completion and total attempt count.

Website users can be suspended, reinstated or permanently deleted from FactVaultManager; suspension revokes sessions and hides leaderboard scores while preserving history, and deletion removes the account and stored scores.
Public usernames now block reserved administration, moderation, support and Factburst impersonation names.
The Factburst profile is upgraded to a dedicated page with overall rank, score totals, accuracy, attempt count and full quiz history.
Verified users can send, accept, decline and cancel friend requests by public username, manage accepted friends from their profile, and remove friends without exposing email addresses.
Quiz results now include Challenge a friend: players can target an accepted Factburst friend or create a shareable 30-day challenge link backed by their stored best score.
Suspended or deleted accounts are excluded from overall and per-quiz leaderboards, friends surfaces and active challenge links.
